questions.question: Two angles of a triangle measure 34 degrees and 46 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add to 180: 180 - 34 - 46 = 100.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: triangle angles always add up to 180.

questions.question: Two angles are complementary. One measures 20 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add to 90 degrees: 90 - 20 = 70.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: complementary adds to 90, like a corner.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 32 degrees and 44 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 32 - 44 = 104.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the name of the line segment from the center of a circle to its edge?
questions.explanation: The radius runs from the center to any point on the circle; the diameter is twice as long and the chord joins two edge points.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: radius is half the diameter.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cube with an edge length of 7 cm?
questions.explanation: Volume = side cubed = 7 x 7 x 7 = 343 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: cube volume is side times side times side.

questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram with a base of 10 cm and a height of 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a parallelogram = base x height = 10 x 5 = 50 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a parallelogram has the area of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 2 cm by 3 cm by 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(6 + 6 + 9) = 42 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: Two triangles are similar. One has a side of 3 cm and the matching side on the other is 6 cm. If another side of the first triangle is 4 cm, what is the matching side?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 2, so multiply 4 by 2 to get 8 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: similar figures keep the same shape, so sides scale together.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 3 cm by 2 cm by 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(6 + 15 + 10) = 62 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 4 cm long, 3 cm wide, and 4 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 4 x 3 x 4 = 48 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: A square pyramid has a base that measures 6 cm by 6 cm. Each of its triangular faces has a height of 5 cm. What is the surface area of the pyramid?
questions.explanation: Surface area counts every face. The square base is 6 x 6 = 36. Each triangular face is 1/2 x 6 x 5 = 15, and there are 4 of them: 4 x 15 = 60. Total: 36 + 60 = 96 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area means wrapping every face, base included.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle with a radius of 3 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Area = pi x radius squared = 3.14 x 3 x 3 = 28.26 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circle area uses radius squared, not diameter.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 cm and 10 cm and height 4 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (base 1 + base 2) x height = 1/2 x 16 x 4 = 32 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trapezoid averages its two bases, then multiplies by height.

questions.question: Two angles of a triangle measure 78 degrees and 62 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add to 180: 180 - 78 - 62 = 40.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: triangle angles always add up to 180.

questions.question: In which quadrant is the point (1, 6)?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are positive, so the point is in Quadrant I.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant I is the top-right, where both numbers are positive.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 13 = 26 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 6 cm long, 4 cm wide, and 3 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 6 x 4 x 3 = 72 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 11 = 22 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: An angle measures 35 degrees. What is the measure of its complement?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add to 90 degrees, because together they fill a right angle. So subtract the known angle: 90 - 35 = 55 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: complements complete a corner - together they make 90.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 56 degrees. What does the other measure?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are always equal, so the other is also 56 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 10 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = pi x diameter = 3.14 x 10 = 31.4 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is pi times the diameter.

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 12 cm. What is its diameter?
questions.explanation: The diameter is twice the radius: 2 x 12 = 24 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: diameter goes all the way across, radius only halfway.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 42 degrees and 43 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 42 - 43 = 95.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is a polygon with 5 sides called?
questions.explanation: Penta- means five, so a 5-sided polygon is a pentagon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: count the sides to name the polygon.

questions.question: A real fence is 24 meters long. On a scale drawing, 1 cm represents 3 meters. How long is the fence on the drawing?
questions.explanation: A scale drawing shrinks real lengths, so divide the real length by the scale: 24 / 3 = 8 cm on the drawing.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: going from real life to paper, divide by the scale.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a diameter of 20 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = pi x diameter = 3.14 x 20 = 62.8 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is pi times the diameter.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 2 cm by 2 cm by 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(4 + 6 + 6) = 32 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: Two triangles are similar. One has a side of 4 cm and the matching side on the other is 12 cm. If another side of the first triangle is 6 cm, what is the matching side?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 3, so multiply 6 by 3 to get 18 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: similar figures keep the same shape, so sides scale together.

questions.question: A triangular prism has a triangle base of 8 cm, a triangle height of 5 cm, and a prism length of 12 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: First find the triangle area: 1/2 x 8 x 5 = 20. Then multiply by the length 12 to get 240 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: prism volume is base area times length.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 59 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees: 180 - 59 = 121.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: supplementary adds to 180, like a straight line.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 37 degrees. What does the other measure?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are always equal, so the other is also 37 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 5 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 x pi x radius = 2 x 3.14 x 5 = 31.4 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is the distance around the circle.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 6 cm and a height of 10 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 6 x 10 = 30 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: In which quadrant is the point (-2, 2)?
questions.explanation: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in Quadrant II.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant II is top-left: negative x, positive y.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 12 cm long and 4 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 16 = 32 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle with a radius of 6 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Area = pi x radius squared = 3.14 x 6 x 6 = 113.04 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circle area uses radius squared, not diameter.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle with a radius of 5 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Area = pi x radius squared = 3.14 x 5 x 5 = 78.5 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circle area uses radius squared, not diameter.

questions.question: Two vertical angles are formed by crossing lines. One measures 64 degrees. What does the other measure?
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are always equal, so the other is also 64 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: angles across from each other are twins.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 6 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 2 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 6 x 2 x 2 = 24 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 57 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees: 180 - 57 = 123.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: supplementary adds to 180, like a straight line.

questions.question: Three angles of a quadrilateral measure 70, 78, and 89 degrees. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360: 360 - 70 - 78 - 89 = 123.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: four-sided figures have angles that add to 360.

questions.question: A shape is a rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm with a triangle on top that has a base of 6 cm and a height of 4 cm. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle: 8 x 4 = 32. Triangle: 1/2 x 6 x 4 = 12. Total = 44 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: break a tricky shape into simple pieces.

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a polygon with 5 sides?
questions.explanation: The sum is (n - 2) x 180 = 3 x 180 = 540 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: each extra side adds 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with an edge length of 4 cm?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces of 4 x 4, so 6 x 16 = 96 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cube has six identical square faces.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 10 cm long and 6 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length x width = 10 x 6 = 60 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rectangle area is length times width.

questions.question: A triangular prism has a triangle base of 6 cm, a triangle height of 5 cm, and a prism length of 7 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: First find the triangle area: 1/2 x 6 x 5 = 15. Then multiply by the length 7 to get 105 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: prism volume is base area times length.

questions.question: Three angles of a quadrilateral measure 79, 85, and 67 degrees. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360: 360 - 79 - 85 - 67 = 129.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: four-sided figures have angles that add to 360.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 cm and 12 cm and height 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (base 1 + base 2) x height = 1/2 x 18 x 5 = 45 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trapezoid averages its two bases, then multiplies by height.

questions.question: A circular sticker has a diameter of 8 cm. What is its area? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: The area formula needs the radius, so first halve the diameter: 8 / 2 = 4 cm. Then Area = pi x radius squared = 3.14 x 4 x 4 = 50.24 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: halve the diameter before you square anything.

questions.question: Two lines cross each other. One of the angles measures 118 degrees. What is the measure of the angle adjacent to it?
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles formed by crossing lines sit on a straight line, so they are supplementary and add to 180 degrees: 180 - 118 = 62 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: neighbors on a straight line always add to 180.

questions.question: Which formula gives the area of a circle?
questions.explanation: Circle area is pi times the radius squared.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: area needs r squared, circumference needs 2 pi r.

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 3 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 x pi x radius = 2 x 3.14 x 3 = 18.84 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: circumference is the distance around the circle.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 51 degrees and 67 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 51 - 67 = 62.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 12 cm and a height of 8 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 12 x 8 = 48 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: On a scale drawing, 1 cm represents 4 meters. A wall is 10 cm long on the drawing. How long is the real wall?
questions.explanation: Multiply the drawing length by the scale: 10 x 4 = 40 meters.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: scale drawings multiply every length by the same number.

questions.question: What is a polygon with 8 sides called?
questions.explanation: A polygon with 8 sides is an octagon.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: count the sides to name the polygon.

questions.question: Two angles of a triangle measure 41 degrees and 68 degrees. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add to 180: 180 - 41 - 68 = 71.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: triangle angles always add up to 180.

questions.question: A triangle with all three sides the same length is called what kind of triangle?
questions.explanation: Equi- means equal, so a triangle with all three sides equal is equilateral.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: equi means equal, iso means same, scalene means uneven.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One measures 23 degrees. What is the measure of the other?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add to 180 degrees: 180 - 23 = 157.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: supplementary adds to 180, like a straight line.

questions.question: A triangle with one angle of 90 degrees is called what kind of triangle?
questions.explanation: A triangle with one 90-degree angle is a right triangle - the right angle is the corner where two sides meet at 90 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a right angle makes a right triangle - look for the little square corner.

questions.question: What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 8 cm and 12 cm and height 4 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x (base 1 + base 2) x height = 1/2 x 20 x 4 = 40 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a trapezoid averages its two bases, then multiplies by height.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 10 cm long and 7 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length x width = 10 x 7 = 70 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rectangle area is length times width.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with an edge length of 3 cm?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces of 3 x 3, so 6 x 9 = 54 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cube has six identical square faces.

questions.question: A point is reflected over the x-axis. Its y-coordinate becomes what?
questions.explanation: Reflecting over the x-axis flips the y-coordinate to its opposite.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: x-axis reflection flips up and down.

questions.question: The point (2, 2) lies in which quadrant?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are positive, so the point is in Quadrant I.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant I is the top-right, where both numbers are positive.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length x width = 8 x 3 = 24 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: rectangle area is length times width.

questions.question: In which quadrant is the point (-3, 4)?
questions.explanation: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in Quadrant II.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant II is top-left: negative x, positive y.

questions.question: A square pyramid has a base that is 9 cm by 9 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is the volume of the pyramid?
questions.explanation: A pyramid holds exactly one third of a prism with the same base and height. The base area is 9 x 9 = 81, so Volume = 1/3 x 81 x 10 = 270 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a pyramid is one third of its prism twin.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a rectangular prism that is 4 cm by 4 cm by 2 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area = 2(lw + lh + wh) = 2(16 + 8 + 8) = 64 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: surface area adds up all six faces.

questions.question: A cylinder is sliced by a flat cut that goes straight across it, parallel to its bases. What shape is the cross section?
questions.explanation: A cut made parallel to a solid's base copies the shape of that base. The bases of a cylinder are circles, so the cross section is a circle the same size as the base.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cut parallel to the base copies the base.

questions.question: What is the volume of a rectangular prism that is 3 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 3 cm tall?
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 3 x 2 x 3 = 18 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: volume fills the box: length times width times height.

questions.question: What is the area of a semicircle with a diameter of 10 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: The radius is half the diameter: 10 / 2 = 5 cm. A full circle would have area 3.14 x 5 x 5 = 78.5, and a semicircle is exactly half of the circle: 78.5 / 2 = 39.25 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: find the whole circle first, then take half.

questions.question: A triangle with no sides the same length is called what kind of triangle?
questions.explanation: Scalene comes from a Greek word for uneven - no sides match, so the triangle is scalene.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: equi means equal, iso means same, scalene means uneven.

questions.question: Two angles are supplementary. One angle is 4 times as large as the other. What is the measure of the smaller angle?
questions.explanation: Call the smaller angle x. The larger angle is 4x, and supplementary angles add to 180, so x + 4x = 180. That gives 5x = 180, so x = 36 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: name the small angle x and let the equation do the work.

questions.question: Which part of a circle is a straight segment that joins two points on the circle and passes through its center?
questions.explanation: A segment with both endpoints on the circle that passes through the center is the diameter. It is the longest segment across a circle and equals exactly two radii.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: the diameter dives straight through the center.

questions.question: A shape is a rectangle 10 cm by 5 cm with a triangle on top that has a base of 8 cm and a height of 3 cm. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle: 10 x 5 = 50. Triangle: 1/2 x 8 x 3 = 12. Total = 62 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: break a tricky shape into simple pieces.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder with a radius of 3 cm and a height of 10 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x radius squared x height = 3.14 x 9 x 10 = 282.6 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cylinder is a circle stretched up by its height.

questions.question: Two triangles are similar. One has a side of 6 cm and the matching side on the other is 18 cm. If another side of the first triangle is 4 cm, what is the matching side?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 3, so multiply 4 by 3 to get 12 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: similar figures keep the same shape, so sides scale together.

questions.question: A circle has a radius of 4 cm. What is its diameter?
questions.explanation: The diameter is twice the radius: 2 x 4 = 8 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: diameter goes all the way across, radius only halfway.

questions.question: A shape is made of two rectangles. One rectangle is 9 cm by 3 cm, and the other is 4 cm by 3 cm. What is the total area of the shape?
questions.explanation: Split the shape into its two rectangles and add their areas: 9 x 3 = 27 and 4 x 3 = 12. Total: 27 + 12 = 39 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: chop the shape into rectangles and add the pieces.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder with a radius of 3 cm and a height of 5 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x radius squared x height = 3.14 x 9 x 5 = 141.3 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cylinder is a circle stretched up by its height.

questions.question: The point (-1, 6) is located in which quadrant?
questions.explanation: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in Quadrant II.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant II is top-left: negative x, positive y.

questions.question: An angle that measures exactly 180 degrees is called what kind of angle?
questions.explanation: A straight angle opens all the way to a straight line, which is exactly 180 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight angle is a flat line - 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the area of a parallelogram with a base of 8 cm and a height of 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a parallelogram = base x height = 8 x 5 = 40 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a parallelogram has the area of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: A shape is a rectangle 8 cm by 4 cm with a triangle on top that has a base of 8 cm and a height of 4 cm. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle: 8 x 4 = 32. Triangle: 1/2 x 8 x 4 = 16. Total = 48 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: break a tricky shape into simple pieces.

questions.question: A rectangle is 5 cm long and 2 cm wide. It is enlarged by a scale factor of 3. What is the perimeter of the enlarged rectangle?
questions.explanation: A scale factor multiplies every length: the new sides are 5 x 3 = 15 cm and 2 x 3 = 6 cm. Perimeter = 2 x (15 + 6) = 42 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: every length gets multiplied by the scale factor.

questions.question: Can a triangle be built with side lengths of 3 cm, 4 cm, and 9 cm?
questions.correctAnswer: No - the two short sides add to less than the long side
distractors: Yes - any three lengths can form a triangle
Yes - the longest side is 9 cm
No - a triangle must have all sides equal
questions.explanation: The triangle inequality says the two shorter sides must add to more than the longest side. Here 3 + 4 = 7, which is less than 9, so the short sides cannot reach each other to close the triangle.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: two short sides must reach past the long one.

questions.question: What is the sum of the interior angles of a polygon with 8 sides?
questions.explanation: The sum is (n - 2) x 180 = 6 x 180 = 1080 degrees.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: each extra side adds 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10 cm and a height of 10 cm?
questions.explanation: Area = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 10 x 10 = 50 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height.

questions.question: Two triangles are similar. One has a side of 5 cm and the matching side on the other is 10 cm. If another side of the first triangle is 6 cm, what is the matching side?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 2, so multiply 6 by 2 to get 12 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: similar figures keep the same shape, so sides scale together.

questions.question: A point is reflected over the y-axis. Its x-coordinate becomes what?
questions.explanation: Reflecting over the y-axis flips the x-coordinate to its opposite.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: y-axis reflection flips left and right.

questions.question: A triangular prism has triangular ends with a base of 6 cm and a height of 4 cm. The prism is 10 cm long, and the other two sides of each triangle are 5 cm and 5 cm. What is the surface area of the prism?
questions.explanation: Count all five faces. The two triangular ends: 2 x (1/2 x 6 x 4) = 24. The three rectangular sides: 6 x 10 = 60, plus two of 5 x 10 = 50 each. Total: 24 + 60 + 50 + 50 = 184 square cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a prism wears two triangle ends and three rectangle walls.

questions.question: When two lines cross, what are the angles that sit directly across from each other called?
questions.explanation: Angles that sit opposite each other when two lines cross are called vertical angles. They are formed by the same two lines and always have equal measures.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: vertical angles face off across the crossing - and they match.

questions.question: Three angles sit on a straight line. Two measure 62 degrees and 31 degrees. What is the third?
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line add to 180: 180 - 62 - 31 = 87.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a straight line is 180 degrees.

questions.question: An angle that measures more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees is called what kind of angle?
questions.explanation: An angle bigger than 90 degrees but smaller than 180 degrees is an obtuse angle - wider than a right angle, not yet a straight line.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: acute is sharp and small, obtuse is wide.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle that is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x 19 = 38 cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: perimeter walks all the way around.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder with a radius of 2 cm and a height of 6 cm? Use 3.14 for pi.
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x radius squared x height = 3.14 x 4 x 6 = 75.36 cubic cm.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: a cylinder is a circle stretched up by its height.

questions.question: Which quadrant contains the point (3, 4)?
questions.explanation: Both coordinates are positive, so the point is in Quadrant I.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: Quadrant I is the top-right, where both numbers are positive.

questions.question: Three angles of a quadrilateral measure 76, 60, and 94 degrees. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360: 360 - 76 - 60 - 94 = 130.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: four-sided figures have angles that add to 360.

questions.question: On a scale drawing, 1 cm represents 3 meters. A wall is 6 cm long on the drawing. How long is the real wall?
questions.explanation: Multiply the drawing length by the scale: 6 x 3 = 18 meters.
questions.memoryHook: T-Rexy says: scale drawings multiply every length by the same number.
